groups.title: Garage Door Repair
groups.summary: A door that’s grinding, hanging off track, or refusing to close usually points to a mechanical issue rather than a full replacement.
groups.intro: A door that’s grinding, hanging off track, or refusing to close usually points to a mechanical issue rather than a full replacement. Our technicians diagnose the cause first, then walk through garage door repair options that fix the actual problem instead of guessing at parts.

groups.title: Garage Door Spring Repair and Replacement
groups.summary: A door that won’t stay open, slams shut, or sounds like it’s straining to lift usually means a worn or broken spring.
groups.intro: A door that won’t stay open, slams shut, or sounds like it’s straining to lift usually means a worn or broken spring, one of the most common and most dangerous problems to attempt as a DIY fix. Garage door spring repair and replacement is handled by licensed technicians using the correct spring tension for your door’s size and weight.

groups.title: Garage Door Opener Repair
groups.intro: A remote that stops responding, a motor that hums without moving the door, and safety sensors that won’t align are common opener symptoms with different fixes. Our garage door opener repair technicians diagnose which one is actually failing before replacing anything.

groups.title: Custom Gates & Access Control
groups.summary: Secure your property with a custom-designed driveway gate. We install and repair all types of gates, including automatic and sliding models, and integrate modern access control systems to give you complete control and peace of mind.
groups.intro: Secure your property with a custom-designed driveway gate. We install and repair all types of gates, including automatic and sliding models, and integrate modern access control systems to give you complete control and peace of mind.

groups.title: Garage Door Track Repair and Realignment
groups.summary: A misaligned or damaged track can prevent your garage door from opening or closing properly.
groups.intro: A misaligned or damaged track can prevent your garage door from opening or closing properly. Over time, this can lead to more serious damage if not addressed. Our technicians specialize in realigning and repairing tracks to ensure your door moves smoothly along its path.

about.title: About My Garage And Gates
text: We are Houston’s single source for securing and enhancing your property’s entire perimeter. From custom fence and gate installations to reliable garage door service, our expert team delivers seamless solutions for both residential and commercial clients.

Securing your Houston home or business shouldn’t be a hassle. At My Garage And Gates, we simplify the entire process by being your one-stop expert for fences, gates, and garage doors. Forget the headache of calling three different companies! Our dedicated team handles everything from design to installation, ensuring your whole perimeter not only looks great but works together perfectly. We’re committed to expert craftsmanship and your total satisfaction, delivering security and curb appeal in one seamless project.

A functional and secure garage door is essential. We offer professional installation of new garage doors and provide prompt, reliable repair services to keep your home or business safe and accessible. See our recent garage door installation in Houston, TX.
